subject.title: feat: add copyable message citation links

question: Should ClickClack permanently allocate public M route IDs to every channel-root message at creation and backfill that identity onto historical channel roots?
rationale: This is a new durable public-routing and stored-data contract, not only a UI action; the remaining tests can prove safety but cannot choose whether that permanent product boundary is desired.

options.title: Adopt channel-root citations
options.body: Keep the feature direction and require explicit legacy-store upgrade coverage before merge.

options.title: Narrow the route contract
options.body: Limit citation routes to a smaller supported subset and revise the persistence/backfill behavior before continuing review.

options.title: Defer durable citations
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers decide whether public message identity belongs in the core routing model.

recommendation.title: Adopt channel-root citations
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction and require explicit legacy-store upgrade coverage before merge.
